title: Drizzle #3680: TypeError Cannot destructure resourceArn of connection as undefined

error_signal.message: drizzle-orm TypeError: Cannot destructure property 'resourceArn' of 'connection' as it is undefined in AWS Data API pg driver

ground_truth.root_cause_description: ESM/CJS module mismatch causes the AWS SDK connection object to be undefined when imported. The driver destructures properties without checking for null.
ground_truth.fix_description: Fix module import to handle ESM/CJS interop correctly
